FAIL_TO_PASS: cycles-stack-overflow: does not stack overflow on crazy cyclical dependencies
tdz-common: preserve common TDZ violations
if-statement-breaks: handles conditionally broken execution
string-replace-side-effects: does not assume string.replace has side effects when called with a string as second argument
side-effects-switch-statements: switch statements should be correctly tree-shaken
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
supports-core-js: supports core-js
loop-errors: does not break flow from inside loops that may not have executed
optional-chaining-missing-properties: supports optional chaining for missing properties
side-effects-call-arguments: side-effects in call arguments should be included
treeshake-sequence-expressions: removes the last element of a sequence expression if it is unused
break-statement-labels-in-loops: handles breaking to loops inside labeled statements
for-in-scopes: properly associate or shadow variables in and around for-in-loops
class-static-initialization-block: supports class static initialization blocks
modify-class-prototype: tree-shakes prototype modifications of classes
deoptimize-superclass: does not deoptimize the entire superclass when reassigning a property
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
multi-expression-calls: handles side-effect-free multi-expressions
for-of-scopes: properly associate or shadow variables in and around for-of-loops
try-statement-arguments: includes referenced call arguments to functions called from try statements
